about: Each card field (card.*, ext.*, and the objects nested in ext) says where a
group member's value is edited (editor) and where a group turn reads it per
member (reader), or gives one reasoned exemption: groupWide, notRead,
soloOnly, origin or runtimeOnly. noEditor / noPhone say why a control is
missing. A place is a pointer ({path, in: function, marker}), not proof of
behaviour. note is for people; the test does not read it.

opaqueTypes.Lorebook: a lorebook is edited as one book in the Lorebook tab and read as one book for the speaker; its entries are not card fields
opaqueTypes.AvatarImage: gallery rows of the library card (looks and expressions); a member inherits the origin card's

spine.why: Edit group opens Edit Character on a member
and saves it to the member's row
the open group chat's sidebar saves a member's edit to its row
UI Settings saves a member's colours and lock to its row
the row stores the whole extensions, every field the codec writes
and the group loads them back
the phone's editor posts a member to the group's route
the relay takes the member edit
applies the page's fields to the member
and saves them to the member's row
a member's start goes to the group's seed for them
the page's Realism fields go through the relay
